plain_text:
Command Performance was an Armed Forces Radio Service variety program created during World War II for U.S. service personnel overseas.

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Carlos Ramirez (performer), Jack Carson (performer), Jack Oakie (performer), Martha Stewart (host), Peter Lorre (performer), Sydney Greenstreet (performer), and Verna Felton (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to Armed Forces Radio Service.

The stories often return to World War II and music and variety performance.
